§6The Builder§f

§aThe ultimate all-in-one machine for building, quarrying, pumping, and voiding.§f

The §bBuilder§f places blocks, digs quarries, moves entities, and pumps liquids over huge areas. It's the Swiss Army knife of RFTools.

§6Specs§f: §e1,000,000 RF§f buffer, §e20,000 RF/t§f input, shapes up to §e512×512×512§f blocks.

§6Energy Per Operation§f:
§b• Build§f: §e500 RF§f/block
§b• Pump§f: §e300 RF§f/block
§b• Quarry§f: §e300 RF§f base (scales with hardness)
§b• Move entity§f: §e5,000 RF§f
§b• Teleport player§f: §e40,000 RF§f

§6Quarry Cards§f:
§b• Normal§f: Mines and replaces with Dirt. §e1.0×§f
§b• Fortune§f: Fortune on ores. §c2.0×§f
§b• Silk Touch§f: Silk Touch on everything. §c3.0×§f
§b• Clearing§f: Mines and leaves void. §a0.5×§f

§9Note:§f Place an inventory above or below the Builder to supply blocks (building) or receive drops (quarrying).
